svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut an 80 mm disc from plated-hole prototype board (2.54 mm grid):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: scribe the circle, cut outside it with a coping saw, file to the line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three stack holes 3.4 mm on a 60 mm circle at 0, 120 and 240 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three notches 11 mm wide, from 25 mm radius out to the edge, at 60, 180

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 300 degrees: the dome bosses pass up through them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Parts, from the mains board layout picture: supply 23 x 38 mm on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre; relay on the pole side; varistor and thermal fuse at the left

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge and metering module at the right edge, seen from the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm hole at 28 mm toward the street, 22 mm right: low-voltage leads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep 6 mm of bare board between mains tracks and the 12 V side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit a 3-way mains terminal block and a 6-way harness header.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits on three 12 mm spacers; standoffs screw on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat; the dome bosses pass the notches freely.
